summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K on 30 October 2026 disclosing a PDMR transaction under the UK Market Abuse Regulation. Independent Non-Executive Director Alison Platt purchased 12,338 ordinary shares of US$0.50 each on 29 October 2026 on the London Stock Exchange Main Market at an average price of 12.9672 GBP per share, for a total of 159,989.31 GBP. This is a routine insider shareholding notification, equivalent to a US Form 4 ownership disclosure, with no board recommendation, advisor, or structural/regulatory aspects. No special-situation angle or risk-arb implication exists.
